title: Seville history walking tour
text: Joan was amazing.  Very personable. Fun and extremely knowledgeable.  Sharing the history of a Sevilla with us left us with a much deeper understanding of this city and country and region.  He touched on all aspects of Seville and made it fun.  It was great because Joan is  very engaging.  We highly recommend this tour!
author: Z378WYedwardk

title: A fun way to explore Seville
text: We had the most interesting small group tour with Guille, a young local, as our guide.  Fascinating places, great views and historic insights. We are English speaking and his language skills are excellent. As a group we also had time for a drink together 👍
author: Chris S

title: Interesting views of the city
text: The guide had very good knowledge of the city, its history and current events. In a very entertaining way he reported on many things and showed the city from different perspectives.
author: hjsedlmayr

title: Rooftop tour- a great evening
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our tour.  When we arrived we discovered that we were the only 2 on it, which was a great surprise. Óscar was friendly, personable and knowledgeable; we learned lots about the history, legends and secrets of Seville. Thank you for showing us sights and locations that we would otherwise have missed; we went back and visited some the next day. Óscar was good company.
author: Joanna S

title: A fantastic experience
text: We had a lovely evening of touring the rooftops and out-of-the-way places in Seville. Our guide was personable, informative, and made our tour a delight. After our evening, we came away with plenty of great pictures, some excellent recommendations, and a passel of fond memories. It was a fantastic experience.
author: brandonnL9136AD

title: Our Guide Abby Made the Tour the Highlight of our Visit.
text: The highlight of our three short days in Seville was the rooftop walking tour hosted by Abby.  Despite the rain and cloudy weather, Abby's effervescent and amiable personality, love of the history of Seville, and with her intimate knowledge provided a very enjoyable time.  I felt like we were walking with along another friend, enjoying the sights and information.  I would recommend this tour to anybody.
author: rlenglebright

title: Excellent views of city and history
text: Carlos or Carlo was a fantastic tour guide. His friends call him Carlo. We experienced a beautiful historic tour and he was full of information about the history. The rooftops were beautiful and at the end we had a nice summer wine. He gave us many ideas to eat and drink and they all were excellent so far. You will enjoy this tour
author: jeffsO6329QY

title: Unique experience
text: I visited the terraces of Seville with Abby. Even though I was alone, they continued making the journey. Abby told me about everything, history, customs, arts. I've heard legends I've never heard before. Seeing the city from above, from a different perspective, is a truly unique program. Also, I will definitely visit the terraces we visited, just to enjoy the view with a drink in hand!
author: Melinda B

title: Seville at sunset from above
text: walk to the city center at dusk and go up to the roof of some particular hotels. Beautiful view of Seville from a different perspective! Our guide Abby, a prepared nut, accompanied us in a relaxed and familiar atmosphere. Thank you so much!
author: D1907ZKsoniav

title: Excellent tour
text: Brilliant tour Nico our guide was really knowledgeable on Seville and the history of the city. He took us to some really great terraces and the views were stunning - highly recommend.
author: holidaygirl500
